 By WRAL staff
 There are several events across the Triangle to honor veterans on Veterans Day.
 NC State Veterans Day Run - The Jeffrey Wright Military and Veteran Services office and NC State's ROTC units will host the annual Veterans Day Honor Run and Ceremony at the Memorial Belltower starting at 6 a.m.
 Other WRAL Top Stories
 Veterans Day Observance in Cary - Held at Veterans Freedom Park, this event will feature guest speakers and patriotic music from the Old North State Brass Band.
 Veterans Day Celebration in Zebulon - The 10 a.m. ceremony at Zebulon Town Hall will honor military veterans and recognize the sacrifices they and their families have made.
 Brunch for veterans at Chavis Park in Raleigh  - Held at John Chavis Memorial Park and Community Center enjoy light refreshments (while supplies last), connect with local resources, and take part in honoring the incredible veterans whose service and sacrifice have shaped our community throughout history.  
 Rolesville Veterans Day Celebration  - The Community Gardeners of Rolesville, the Rolesville Veterans Group, and the Joel Fund will host a ceremony to celebrate their service and sacrifice at 11 a.m. at Rolesville Town Hall.
 Veterans Day Ceremony in downtown Apex  - Members of Apex public safety, Apex Town Council, and the Apex community share words and hold space for moments of reflection. This event features a ceremony at the downtown service memorial.
 Veterans Day Observance in Garner - Enjoy music and a keynote address, as well as a program to honor those who have bravely served our country. This free event is co-sponsored by the Garner Veterans Advisory Committee. Location: Aversboro Road Baptist Church
